title: Backup and Restore
createDescription: Pack the active project (config, entries, glossary) into a verifiable .zip archive.
backupsListDescription: All backups stored on the server for this project. Click a file to download it.
backupsListEmpty: No backups yet. Create one above.
itemPreImport: Restore point from just before the import of {{date}}
itemPreRetranslate: Restore point from just before the re-translation of {{date}}
restoreDescription: Upload a backup .zip. Checksums are verified before any file is written.
confirmBody: Restoring will overwrite the project's existing config, entries, and glossary files. This action cannot be undone.
deleteConfirmBody: This will permanently delete this backup file from the server. This cannot be undone.
